description: How India overtook China (2023) and what happens next — a 2000–2026 population race showing one giant rising while another begins to shrink.
youtube_description:
India overtook China to become the world’s most populous country (UN estimates placed the crossover in 2023). This timeline traces the story from 2000 to 2026: a steady, multi-decade rise for India versus a plateau and gradual decline in China, while countries like Nigeria rocket upward. We used official population series and UN-based projections to show how demographics are reshaping geopolitics, markets, and the global workforce.

What this means: more consumers, more labor force growth, different age pyramids—and big implications for education, housing, and climate policy. Drop a comment: which country’s future surprises you the most? Subscribe for more data-driven visual stories and hit the bell to catch the full chart-race video.

Sources: UN World Population Prospects, national census releases, and official statistical agencies (annualized figures). If you want the raw dataset or voiceover script for this video, comment below or join the channel membership.
